bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast on discount text and checkout button
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the discount rows in the cart table
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text and button label must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background (or 3:1 for large text) per WCAG 2.1 AA.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Discount spans have contrast ratio 2.16 (foreground #b0b0b0 on #ffffff). Checkout button has contrast ratio 3.13 (foreground #ffffff on #28a745). Both fall below required thresholds.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for tr:nth-child(2) > td:nth-child(3) > span, change color from #b0b0b0 to #747474 (4.67:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.16:1, required 4.5:1).
bugLogs.element_selector: .checkout-btn, tr:nth-child(2) > td:nth-child(3) > span, tr:nth-child(3) > td:nth-child(3) > span

bugLogs.title: Missing language attribute on <html> element
steps_to_reproduce: Open the cart page (cart.html) in a browser
Observe that there is no lang attribute present
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The <html> element must have a valid BCP 47 language code (e.g., lang="en") so assistive technologies can determine the page language.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <html> element is rendered as <html> without a lang attribute.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute to the root element, e.g., change <html> to <html lang="en"> (or the appropriate language code for the page).

bugLogs.title: Product thumbnail images missing alternative text
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect the product thumbnail images in the cart summary
Observe that the elements have no alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role attributes
bugLogs.expected_behavior: All informative images must have a descriptive alt attribute, or be marked as decorative with alt="" or role="presentation".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The and elements lack alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, and role attributes.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to each thumbnail, e.g., html If the images are purely decorative, use `alt=""` or `role="presentation"` instead.

bugLogs.title: Quantity inputs lack accessible labels on cart page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the quantity input fields for items (e.g., <input type="number" value="1"> and <input type="number" value="2">)
Attempt to navigate to each input with a screen reader or keyboard
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each form control must have a programmatically determinable label that is announced by assistive technologies.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The number inputs have no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no placeholder, leaving them unlabeled for screen readers.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add a visible <label> for each input and associate it via the for/id attributes, e.g.,

html
<label for="qty-1">Quantity</label>
<input id="qty-1" type="number" name="quantity1" value="1" min="1" max="10" style="width:50px;" aria-label="Quantity for item 1">

<label for="qty-2">Quantity</label>
<input id="qty-2" type="number" name="quantity2" value="2" min="1" max="10" style="width:50px;" aria-label="Quantity for item 2">
